rows.question: Which dogs have not cost their owner more than 1000 for treatment ? List the dog names .
rows.pred_sql:
WITH owners_with_dogs AS (
    SELECT o.owner_id, o.first_name, o.last_name, d.dog_id, d.name
    FROM Owners o
    JOIN Dogs d ON o.owner_id = d.owner_id
),
dogs_with_treatment_costs AS (
    SELECT d.dog_id, d.name, SUM(t.cost_of_treatment) AS total_treatment_cost
    FROM Dogs d
    LEFT JOIN Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id
    GROUP BY d.dog_id, d.name
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.name
FROM dogs_with_treatment_costs d
JOIN owners_with_dogs o ON d.dog_id = o.dog_id
WHERE d.total_treatment_cost <= 1000
ORDER BY d.name
LIMIT 100

    FROM Dogs d

    GROUP BY d.dog_id, d.name
),
owners_with_total_treatment_cost AS (
